ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to make Ownership, Vertical Market, and All customer contact fields required if a related opportunity is at proposal stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_at_Proposal_Stage__c = TRUE, NOT(RecordType.Name = "Competitor"), NOT(RecordType.Name = "Partner"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Vertical_Market__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Ownership,""), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contact_Level__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contact_Department__c,""), ISBLANK(Customer_Contact_Email__c), ISBLANK(Customer_Contact_Name__c), ISBLANK(Customer_Contact_Title_Designation__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Vertical Market, Ownership, and all Customer Contact Fields are required on the Account when an Opportunity reaches Proposal Stage.
